name: Rotavirus
short_description: Non-enveloped, wheel-shaped triple-layered icosahedral dsRNA virus (~75 nm across the smooth rim, ~100 nm including its spikes) of the Sedoreoviridae; named from Latin rota, "wheel", because in negative-stain EM the short blunt VP4 spikes around a sharp rim make it look like a spoked wheel. It packs 11 double-stranded RNA segments inside a VP2 core wrapped in VP6 and an outer VP7 shell, and is the leading cause of severe dehydrating gastroenteritis in infants worldwide.

textbook.1: ❌ FAIL (gemini-2.5-flash-image) — baked-in text: the protein names "VP1" and "RP3" were lettered into the image. The VP4 spikes were drawn as long stalked clubs projecting about a third of the particle's diameter — the coronavirus silhouette the reference explicitly forbids — and the virion was a flat concentric-ring cross-section rather than a cut-away of a three-dimensional particle. A stray black dot sat on the outer rim. Fix-prompt: forbid every protein name explicitly; make the spikes broad-based blunt cog teeth projecting one tenth of the diameter; draw a 3D sphere with one triangular wedge lifted out.
textbook.2: ✅ PASS (gemini-3-pro-image) — a three-dimensional faceted sphere with a clean triangular wedge cut out, on dark charcoal, filling the frame with no border or vignette. Correctly NAKED and NON-ENVELOPED: no membrane anywhere. The three shells are in the right order and each its own colour — cerulean VP7 outside (tiled with triangular trimers and dimpled with slate channel pores), sea-green VP6 beneath it, dusty violet VP2 innermost — with a bundle of coppery dsRNA rods inside and exactly one indigo (VP1) plus one terracotta (VP3) lobe. The spikes are short blunt bilobed studs projecting roughly a tenth of the diameter, so the spoked-wheel outline reads. No text, no frame. Chosen as the label base. Minor: the outline weight is a touch heavier and the blue a touch more saturated than the muted house palette of `rhinovirus__textbook`, and about thirteen RNA rods are drawn rather than exactly eleven.

sem.1: ⚠️ PARTIAL (gemini-2.5-flash-image) — convincing false-colour SEM surface (cerulean body, triangular tiling, visible channel pores, no envelope, no text, no border), but the VP4 spikes were long thin stalks with knobbed heads projecting about a third of the diameter: unmistakably the coronavirus club look the reference forbids. Fix-prompt: spikes become squat blunt cog teeth, wider than long, one tenth of the diameter.
sem.2: ⚠️ PARTIAL (gemini-2.5-flash-image) — the spike geometry was fixed (twelve short blunt rectangular studs) and the wheel outline now reads, but the render lost its micrograph character: a smooth, evenly geometric felt-or-clay model rather than a photographic SEM plate, with no depth of field, no detector grain and no contact shadow. Fix-prompt: demand genuine micrograph character — granular sputter texture, specular micro-highlights, shallow depth of field, faint detector noise, a soft contact shadow — and about twenty studs.
sem.3: ✅ PASS (gemini-3-pro-image) — reads as a real high-magnification SEM plate: fine granular sputter texture, believable micro-highlights, shallow depth of field softening the lower edge, faint frame-wide grain and a soft contact shadow on the substrate. Single naked non-enveloped particle, crisp circular rim, dense triangular protein mosaic with clearly sunken round channel pores, and about twenty short blunt amber studs projecting roughly a tenth of the diameter — the spoked wheel. Cerulean-on-slate-teal false colour, surface only (no internals, which is correct for SEM), fills the frame edge-to-edge, no text, no border, no duplicates.

3d.1: ⚠️ PARTIAL (gemini-2.5-flash-image) — layer order correct (cerulean VP7 → sea-green VP6 → violet VP2 → coppery RNA rods) and no envelope, but the spikes were long dumbbell-shaped clubs, the shells were rendered as an oval rather than a sphere, and two indigo and two terracotta lobes were drawn instead of a single VP1/VP3 pair. Fix-prompt: shorten and blunt the spikes; make the particle perfectly round; exactly one lobe pair.
3d.2: ❌ FAIL (gemini-2.5-flash-image) — the shell ORDER was wrong: the dusty-violet VP2 layer was drawn immediately under VP7 and outside the sea-green VP6 layer, inverting the two inner shells, with an empty dark gap between them. Amber spikes also floated inside the opened cavity and extra amber blobs were scattered over the outer surface. Fix-prompt: state the outside-in order explicitly and insist the violet layer is innermost, flush against the green, directly enclosing the genome; spikes only on the intact outer surface; no other surface lumps.
3d.3: ⚠️ PARTIAL (gemini-3-pro-image) — the layer order is now correct and the spikes are short blunt bilobed studs, but the shells read as hard glossy plastic wedges snapped together like a construction toy, the tints are candy-bright rather than natural, and only about nine RNA segments are visible. Fix-prompt: soft translucent organic protein with a matte biological sheen, desaturated natural tints, subunits merging smoothly, exactly eleven twisted dsRNA rods.
3d.4: ✅ PASS (gemini-3-pro-image) — soft, slightly translucent organic protein in natural desaturated tints on a clean dark studio background, filling the frame with no border or vignette. Correct outside-in order with the shells stacked flush: muted cerulean VP7 carrying the amber spikes, sea-green VP6 of triangular trimer pillars directly beneath, dusty violet VP2 innermost enclosing the genome. Short blunt bilobed spikes give the spoked-wheel profile; the surface carries the round channel pores; exactly one indigo VP1 lobe and one terracotta VP3 lobe sit together at a vertex. Coppery genome segments are drawn as gently twisted double-helical rods (correct for dsRNA, no base-pair rungs). No envelope, no text, no face. Chosen. Known compromise: only seven or eight genome rods are visible in the opened quadrant rather than a countable eleven.

watercolor.1: ❌ FAIL (gemini-2.5-flash-image) — baked-in text: "VP1" and "VP2" were lettered onto the plate. The spikes were long trumpet-mouthed stalks, and the genome was painted as a striped disc rather than eleven separate segments. The aged paper did correctly fill the frame corner-to-corner with no mat or sheet. Fix-prompt: forbid every protein name explicitly; short blunt spikes; eleven distinct rods; paint a 3D sphere with a wedge cut out.
watercolor.2: ✅ PASS (gemini-3-pro-image) — warm aged cream paper with foxing fills the entire frame corner-to-corner and the subject sits on a soft dark wash halo painted directly onto it: no sheet, mat, border, frame or drop shadow. The virion is a three-dimensional faceted sphere with a painterly wedge cut out, correctly naked and non-enveloped, showing cerulean VP7 with channel pores outside, sea-green VP6 in the middle and dusty violet VP2 innermost, with coppery genome rods and one indigo plus one terracotta lobe. No text anywhere. Minor: the spikes are painted with a slightly narrower neck and a flared head than the blunt cog teeth of the other styles, so they sit at the long end of what the reference allows, and roughly twelve genome rods are drawn rather than eleven.

reference: ✅ PASS — CDC Public Health Image Library image #178 (CDC/Dr. Erskine Palmer, photo credit Bryon Skinner, 1981), the iconic negative-stain transmission electron micrograph of rotavirus, digitally colorized by CDC; public domain, no copyright restrictions. Native file 2700 x 2083 px, so the 1080 square shown here is a DOWNSCALE, not an upscale. Visual check: a field of intact triple-layered particles, each showing the sharp outer rim with a fringe of short radial spikes over a lighter hub — exactly the 'spoked wheel' that gave the genus its name — with no envelope and no long club spikes, matching the science reference. Two processing notes, both recorded honestly. (a) An attempt to clean the plate with `edit_image.py` (gemini-2.5-flash-image) was REJECTED and deleted: it redrew the virions as small stylised discs with drawn-on spikes floating on a flat blank background, destroying the photographic negative-stain texture — a re-illustration, not a clean. (b) The displayed reference (`real-02__TEM-crop`) is therefore a purely DETERMINISTIC crop with no generative editing at all: a 1020 x 1020 px region of the native CDC TIFF taken at (90, 480) and Lanczos-resampled to 1080 x 1080, a 1.06x upscale that is effectively native resolution. It shows about ten well-separated particles at roughly twice the magnification of the full-field version, so each rim and its ring of short spikes is clearly readable. No pixels invented, no shapes altered, CDC's false colour untouched. The full uncropped plate is kept as `real-01__TEM` for provenance.
